text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: spike in 5xx + tail latency on inference fleet in us-west-2a (inference-prod-usw2a). AlertID: A-6842-ERR.

jordan-oncall: ack — I'll take this. seeing elevated 502/504 and grpc timeouts on model-serving nodes.

maria-eng: I'm looking at the control-plane metrics; heartbeat miss rate to the zone's proxy pool increased ~10:12 UTC. DNS resolution latency to resolver cluster also jumped.

eli-ml: quick question — are models OOMing or network timing out? any KV cache errors?

jordan-oncall: logs show GRPC econnreset and `kvcache` repop warnings, not obvious OOMs. 99th token latency up from 180ms -> ~1.6s. throughput down ~25%.

nina-cs: CS report: three enterprise customers reported API 500s and delayed responses ~10:15-10:20 UTC. we're preparing notices.

ops-bot: linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-usw2a-network-deg (recommended steps: shift-traffic, increase replicas, check resolver endpoints)

maria-eng: initiating traffic shift: set routing policy `region:us-west-2, prefer:us-west-2b, weight:20%` for inference-prod route. command: `rdctl routing shift --route inference-prod --to-region us-west-2b --weight 20`

jordan-oncall: executed shift. monitoring dashboards. CPU/gpu utilization in 2b fine.

eli-ml: propose a quick model-fallback for latency-sensitive routes: route 15% of requests to quantized-ggml-v2-small to reduce token latency while capacity recovers.

maria-eng: applied model-fallback for `latency-critical` tag. config snippet: ```json
{"route":"latency-critical","fallback_model":"ggml-v2-small-q4","pct":15}
```

jordan-oncall: KV cache regen observed after shifting traffic — miss rate improving. 5xx rate down from 8% -> 3% within 6 minutes.

nina-cs: sending proactive note to affected accounts: short blurb + expected mitigation steps. I'll escalate to enterprise AMs.

ops-bot: note: DNS resolver endpoint us-west-2a shows increased retry rate to 169.254.169.253; customer VPCs unaffected. Suggest follow-up with cloud provider.

maria-eng: opened ticket with provider attaching tcpdump and resolver latency graphs. case# CP-6842-RESOLVE.

eli-ml: can we enable temporary autoscale bump for ephemeral pool in 2a to absorb tail?

jordan-oncall: bump scheduled: `replicas +30%` on ephemeral nodes for inference-prod-usw2a, will monitor memory and qps.

maria-eng: bump completed. added short cooldown to avoid oscillation.

nina-cs: customers acknowledged the note, two smaller customers confirmed restored performance.

jordan-oncall: follow-up checklist: 1) keep trafficshift active at 20% until resolver RTT stable, 2) monitor 5xx <1%, 3) escalate to infra if packetloss persists.

maria-eng: handing pager to night shift (maria-eng) for continued watch. summary: control-plane heartbeat + resolver latency caused GRPC timeouts -> traffic shift + model fallback + autoscale mitigated impact.

eli-ml: lock-in follow-up actions: correlation between resolver tail and KV cache misses — we should add synthetic checks that exercise resolver + kvcache warming.

nina-cs: I'll draft a customer post-incident note once we have final RCA.

jordan-oncall: thanks team. tagging oncall-retrospective channel and closing incident alert when 5xx stable. :thumbsup:
